name: phaser
description: Pointer-only preset for the Phaser 2D web game framework. Surfaces the vendor's canonical skill suite (`phaserjs/phaser/skills/`, 28 SKILL.md files including a v3-to-v4 migration skill, MIT) at install time. Ships zero foundation skill filter, zero marketplace plugin, and zero defaults override — the authority comes from the vendor (validated via the marketplace-audit methodology), not from maintainer production use. See `docs/recipes/recommended-vendor-skills.md` §Phaser for the recipe entry and `specs/presets-vendor-pointer-tier/spec.md` for the tier semantics.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Canonical Phaser skill suite published by the vendor (28 SKILL.md files including game-setup-and-config, scenes, sprites, physics (Arcade and Matter.js), tilemaps, animations, input, particles, cameras, audio, plus a v3-to-v4 migration skill). Updated alongside each framework release.

outOfScope: Foundation skill curation — this preset deliberately ships no `foundation.skills.keep/drop` filter (vendor-pointer tier)
Opinionated install-time defaults (CI, hooks, MCP, Docker, design style) — inherited from foundation defaults
Renderer-only stacks — see adjacent options in `docs/recipes/recommended-vendor-skills.md` (PixiJS via `arimxyer/toolchest`)
Simpler component-based frameworks — Kaplay and Excalibur listed as adjacent options in the recipe
Native mobile / desktop wrappers — out of foundation scope
